fusions.name: Quick Dunk
fusions.desc: A quick snap that deals 4 damage, leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds, and has a 40% chance of [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Spreading Wake
fusions.desc: Sweeps a wave through a cone 3 tiles ahead, dealing 11 damage and leaving each enemy [Soaked] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each spread to enemies within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Shrugged Off
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 conditions from you, and your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Rolls Off the Back
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a dodge that failed is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
